data.text:
In view of the “Lord Sri Krishna Janmashtami Mahotsava” organized by the ISKCON temple authorities on 16.08.2025 at Iskcon temple Abids, Hyderabad, the following traffic will be stopped for a while or diverted in the below mentioned routes from 4 a.m. to  11 p.m.:

Route/Junctions to be Avoided from 4 a.m. to 11 p.m.:
Yousuf & Company – Jawaharlal Nehru Road – Abids Circle – Old Hyderabad Collector Office – Chirag Ali – Nampally Station Road.

Diversion points surrounding to Iskcon Temple, Abids to be avoided from 4 a.m. to 11 p.m.: 

1.Traffic coming from Gunfoundry & Tilak Road Junction towards Nampally Station Road will not be allowed and will be diverted at GPO Junction towards MJ Market.
2.Traffic coming from Jambagh Road & SA Bazar Mosque towards GPO Junction will not be allowed and will be diverted at MJ Market towards Gandhi Bhavan, Chappel Road.  
3.Traffic coming from Nampally towards Koti Bank street will be allowed as usually from HP Petrol Pump – Left - ACB Lane – Yousuf & Company – Troop Bazar – Koti Bank Street.
4.Traffic coming from BJP State office is not allowed towards Tr. PS Abids Junction and diverted towards MJ Market Road.
The commuters are requested to avoid above junctions and take alternative routes to reach their destinations to avoid traffic congestion. In case of any emergency during travel, the commuters are requested to call our traffic help line 9010203626 for travel assistance.  All commuters are requested to follow the above traffic advisory and cooperate with the traffic police.

PARKING ARRANGEMENTS: The Devotees attending to ISKCON Temple, Abids shall park their vehicles at Exhibition Ground, Nampally, Hyderabad.

(D. Joel Davis, IPS.,)
Jt. Commissioner of Police,
Traffic, Hyderabad.
